UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores authenticated user profile details including username, round profile picture, favorite football club, selected abstract theme (including Messi Black & White theme), and enabled league filters.

username.description: The user's display name shown at the top of the upper-right menu.

favoriteClub.description: The user's favorite football club shown in the upper-right menu.

profilePictureId.description: Avatar badge or custom photo identifier for the round profile picture.

photoUrl.description: Optional Google account photo URL or custom URI.

selectedThemeId.description: Selected theme ID from the Top 20 Abstract Football Themes.

enabledLeagues.description: Comma-separated list of league codes toggled on in the top-level filtering bar.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
